summary: PSW-1 mobile parity smoke: verified full end-to-end flow on Expo web preview as cathy@example.com. New Switch modal + validation (submit gated on provider name), list rendering with row/stage/decision-link testIDs, 5-step decision walkthrough with cross-tool context (complaints/cases counts), proceed_with_switch showing LF2 chain and stage transitioning to DECISION CONFIRMED on return, direct-navigation Settlement create + matching-receipt (variance-zero) + shortfall (variance flagged, LOOP-1 dispute copy). All primary flows PASSED. One minor parity/UX issue: settlement status chip label falls back to raw enum on mobile (and web) because STATUS_LABEL map does not include the switch.refund_status values actually written by the backend.

ui_bugs.issue: After recording a refund receipt, the STATUS chip shows the raw uppercase enum (e.g. 'RECEIVED_LESS_THAN_EXPECTED_DISPUTED', 'RECEIVED_MATCHES_EXPECTED', 'PENDING_RECEIPT') because /app/mobile/app/switch-settlement/[sid].tsx STATUS_LABEL only maps settlement.settlement_status keys ('review_complete_refund_pending', 'refund_received_reconciled', 'refund_received_variance_flagged') while the screen actually reads switch.refund_status (backend writes 'pending_receipt' | 'received_matches_expected' | 'received_less_than_expected_disputed').

parity_issues.issue: Both mobile (/app/mobile/app/switch-settlement/[sid].tsx line 12-16) and web (/app/frontend/src/pages/SwitchSettlement.jsx line 12-16) have the same mismatched STATUS map; parity of the bug is preserved but the label is ugly on both. Same fix needed on both surfaces.
parity_issues.expected: Human-friendly label like 'Refund shortfall · dispute opened'

action_items: In /app/mobile/app/switch-settlement/[sid].tsx STATUS_LABEL, add mappings for the actual switch.refund_status values written by /app/backend/routes/psw1.py (pending_receipt → 'Refund pending', received_matches_expected → 'Reconciled', received_less_than_expected_disputed → 'Variance flagged · dispute opened'). Mirror the same fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/SwitchSettlement.jsx STATUS_STYLE.
critical_code_review_comments: STATUS_LABEL / STATUS_STYLE maps in both mobile and web SwitchSettlement pages are keyed on settlement.settlement_status but the code actually reads switch.refund_status → chip always falls back to raw enum after receipt.

Settlement create endpoint is not stage-gated on the backend — mobile lets you create a settlement for any switch (verified during test on a decision_confirmed row). This may or may not be intentional; PSW-1 spec typically expects settlement only after final_settlement_pending. Web parity: same permissive behaviour.
psw1-settle-variance-zero uses a strict variance === 0 check; for backend variance rounded via .toFixed(2) any float noise could show as non-zero. Consider Math.abs(variance) < 0.01.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested mobile flows passed (list+modal validation+create, walkthrough 5 steps+submit+LF2 chain+stage transition, settlement create+match variance-zero, shortfall variance flagged)

seed_data_creation: Created one PSW switch row on Cathy's active participant during test: current_provider_name='TEST_PSW1_1787191113' (id 45aa0970-7caa-4e56-9a64-74568beb90b1). It has been advanced to decision_confirmed and has a $500 refund settlement in refund_received_reconciled state. A pre-existing switch (BlueBerry Care, id bcb5b8f5-...) was used for the shortfall test and now has an $800 expected / $300 received settlement in refund_received_variance_flagged state with a LOOP-1 dispute case opened automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cathy has 5 provider switches now (1 seeded by this run in decision_confirmed with completed reconciled settlement; 1 BlueBerry Care in variance_flagged state; 3 others in deciding). If retesting the modal validation, the check I used was: psw1-modal-submit has aria-disabled='true', opacity 0.55, pointerEvents none when provider name is empty; after typing it becomes aria=null, opacity=1, pointer=auto — worked as expected. Note: fill selector needs 'input[data-testid="psw1-modal-provider"]' not '[data-testid="psw1-modal-provider"] input' for Field component. Same for settle-create-amount and settle-amount-input.
rca of the issue: SwitchSettlement status chip: the mobile screen builds `settlement` from `data.switch` where refund_status is derived from the switch document (values: pending_receipt / received_matches_expected / received_less_than_expected_disputed). The STATUS_LABEL constant however uses the settlement_status keys from the settlement collection. As a result STATUS_LABEL[settlement.refund_status] is always undefined and falls through to the raw refund_status.toUpperCase().
